checks.q: Is the attestation verification fully validated before minting?
Are nonces properly tracked to prevent message replay?
Is the domain mapping between chains correctly configured?
Is the burn-mint flow atomic and resistant to partial execution?
Are token amounts correctly converted between chains with different decimals?
Is the MessageTransmitter address validated against the official deployment?
Are rate limits respected to prevent large unauthorized transfers?
Is the attestation fetch mechanism resilient to API failures?
Are destination callers properly restricted to prevent unauthorized claiming?
Is the integration tested against CCTP version upgrades?
